releases.name: v0.3.2: Documentation Update
releases.body:
## 📝 Documentation

- Polished README and documentation.
- Confirmed stability for daily use.
Add support for auto-updating ocx extensions if installed. Improve logging to reduce noise.
Restore sidebar update logs and disable debug capture. Align release/publish workflows for trusted publishing.
Auto-update logging refinements and release automation.
feat: use standard --log-level DEBUG flag for native compatibility with OpenCode

issues.title: Log path resolves incorrectly when project directory is the user's home
